The 2026 rookie report

Every drafted QB, RB, WR and TE: where he is now, how much of his position's usage left that team, who arrived, and how past rookies taken in the same round scored.

Listed in draft order. That's where NFL teams took them, not a ranking of ours, and nothing here says how a rookie will do. Data as of Nov 1, 2026. 2026 games are through Week 8, in full PPR.

Plan members can ask for it by email after each NFL Draft, with the rookies who landed beside their own players at the top.

How past rookies scored

Rookies drafted since 2014, under full PPR. A "good pace" is 15+ points a game for a QB, 10+ for an RB or WR and 8+ for a TE, over at least 6 games. This is what happened to past classes, not a forecast for this one.
